messages.subject: Adding notes to a plot
parts:
Hi,

It's very common to have notes (maybe stating sample size or data
criteria) at the bottom of a graph, below the x-axis label, outside the
plot margins (I usually place them on the bottom left corner). I use
mtext in the traditional R plots, but how can I add notes in ggplot2?

Thanks,
